fullItemComparison.method: All new XML parsed; current first-page raw item hashes stable on reread. Compare saved baseline structured fields for overlap; prior raw XML/description not available.

jvnIpedia.comparisonLimitation: One overlap row can be compared only on saved structured fields; no claim of prior full XML/description equality. Rows outside the modification window are retained as history, not source deletions.

limitations: Seven independently updated OSV exports, not a synchronized global database snapshot. All baseline/current ZIP records CRC-read and canonical JSON compared, including changes outside the 24-hour overlap.

MAL, other explicitly malicious-dependency notices, informational records and withdrawal histories are distinct; neither new source records nor unmatched backlog are independent active vulnerability counts.
Only source id/aliases establish transitive identity. Related/upstream, names and product-level CPEs do not.
Public artifacts contain allowlisted structured evidence, public source metadata and content digests, not raw HTML/XML, advisory descriptions, exploit examples or unrelated response fields.

MyJVN is a full all-product census within the requested JST modified-date window, not exhaustive package eligibility verification. Raw baseline XML is unavailable; comparisons of prior rows use saved structured fields.
CISA KEV and pending Milo/dcm4che pages failed HTTP403. Previous successful checkpoints and unknown KEV states are preserved.
GitHub REST rate limiting affected candidate API attempts; the new22 curated advisories use successfully fetched primary HTML/text and public databases, not unavailable API payloads.
Prior unresolved dispositions are retained unless this audit explicitly supersedes them. No blanket maintainer recheck of the full unmatched backlog is claimed.
